measurement.numerator_rule: Only matched verified queries receive credit. Trusted setup, exclusions, refusals, unavailable queries and unresolved label chains remain nonpasses.
measurement.proven_core_note: Proven core S1 v6: S1 v5 plus aggregates without GROUP BY (COUNT(*), COUNT, SUM, MIN and MAX, each optionally DISTINCT, inside ordinary outer arithmetic and comparisons). Proved to return exactly one row, to ignore NULL arguments, to give COUNT 0 and SUM/MIN/MAX NULL over empty input, and to keep an exact SUM running total that errors outside 38 digits. Library 106 verified, 0 errors; fixtures 92/92. GROUP BY, HAVING, AVG and joins are not included. Compared with the previous full-suite receipt on the same 622 files: +569,689 matched verified records.
measurement.source_of_final_status: Completed inner and outer receipts (outer completed=True, exit code 0); all 622 per-file archives rehashed against the run's SHA256SUMS and archive receipts (0 mismatches) by a read-only Claude tally whose status totals equal completion.json exactly.

board.why: Queries that use a text, decimal or real column. The proven core handles only integer and NULL values so far; columns a query doesn't use no longer block it.
Arithmetic or functions outside the set the core already proves. Aggregates over a whole table, like COUNT(*) or SUM(a), are now proven and counted.
Sorting, row limits and WITH clauses.

board.what: Table setup (CREATE, INSERT), not yet proven
board.why: The setup statements themselves. They run on trusted code and never count until setup is proven too.
Queries that read more than one table, including joins, which milestone 2 is proving now.

board.what: Setup the core can't load yet
board.why: Earlier setup in the same test file used something the core can't load, so the queries that depend on it can't run there.
Constants like 1.5 or 'a' inside an expression. The proven core accepts integer and NULL constants only.

board.what: GROUP BY and other SELECT clauses
board.why: Queries using GROUP BY, HAVING or other SELECT clauses beyond filtering, choosing columns, DISTINCT and aggregates over the whole table.
Test files that define views are set aside as a whole for now.
Subqueries or functions in FROM, and UNION or other compound queries.

presentation.prove_note: Measured on all 622 files with Assay's verified mode, which is still in development and not yet in the public code. The proven core now also covers SELECT DISTINCT and aggregates without GROUP BY (COUNT, SUM, MIN and MAX, each optionally DISTINCT); earlier full-suite results used smaller cores. Translation into the proven core is trusted, not proven, and so are per-column type admission, SELECT * expansion and aggregate error-witness collection. Table setup is trusted, not proven, and earns no credit. The earlier scalar-model proof marks the track start, not a measured coverage point.
